scenarios.task: Weld inspection access on Molecule Man: rig scaffolding platform at the 30 m sculpture over the Spree to inspect corroded welds on the aluminum figure.
steps: Confirm permit-to-work and lockout of any riverside crane assist
Inspect harness, anchorage points and scaffold tags before ascent
Rig the suspended platform to engineered anchor points on the sculpture
Grind and clean suspect weld seams for visual inspection
Measure weld thickness and photograph defects for the report
Tag any failing seams and barricade below over the riverside path

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off with two lanyards while working over water
Fire watch and extinguisher staged before any grinding
Defect log with photos handed to foreman before end of shift

scenarios.robot_role: Spot carries inspection camera and thickness gauge up the structure to pre-scan welds, reducing trips up the platform.

scenarios.task: Stabilize eroded Spree riverbank beside the Molecule Man sculpture footing after spring high water.
steps: Check the bank undercut and mark the working limit line
Stage geotextile and riprap stone along the marked line
Lay geotextile filter fabric over the scoured slope
Place riprap by hand from the bank side, never wading
Compact and dress the surface, clear the site of debris

rubric.pass_if: No worker enters the water; life ring staged on the bank
Undercut area flagged and no one works below it
Fabric fully covered with stone, no exposed fabric edges

scenarios.robot_role: Husky ferries stone and fabric along the muddy bank path so laborers stay off soft ground near the water.

scenarios.task: Replace corroded dockside lighting conduits and pull new wiring for the tour-boat dock serving Molecule Man visitors.
steps: Isolate the dock lighting circuit and apply lockout-tagout
Verify zero energy with a tested meter at the panel
Remove corroded conduit and fittings along the dock edge
Install new sealed conduit and pull THWN conductors
Terminate, megger test, and re-energize under permit
Function-test all dock lights at dusk
ppe: insulated gloves rated for the panel voltage

rubric.pass_if: Personal locks applied and zero-energy verified before work
All new fittings rated for wet location with drip loops
Insulation resistance test passed before re-energizing

scenarios.task: Service the riverside chiller unit that cools the visitor information kiosk at the Molecule Man plaza.
steps: Lock out the chiller disconnect and verify de-energized
Recover refrigerant to a recovery cylinder per EPA rules
Clean condenser coils and clear debris from riverside intake
Replace the filter drier and check for leaks with detector
Evacuate system, weigh in charge, restart and log pressures

rubric.pass_if: Recovery done with no venting and cylinder logged
Disconnect locked and tagged before any panel opening
Subcooling and superheat readings within manufacturer spec

scenarios.robot_role: Go2 fetches tools and reads zone gauges so the tech keeps hands clear during coil cleaning.

scenarios.task: Spot-repair flaking protective coating on the lower limbs of the Molecule Man aluminum sculpture.
hazards: lead or chromate in old coating
steps: Set up exclusion zone and containment tarps along riverbank path
Test old coating for hazardous content before abrading
Abrade flaking areas with vacuum-shrouded tools
Wipe with solvent prep and mask adjacent surfaces
Apply primer and finish coat matching specified color
Inspect coverage, remove containment, dispose of waste properly

rubric.pass_if: No debris or overspray reaches the river or path
All loose coating removed and edges feathered

scenarios.task: Rig and position a mobile crane to re-torque structural bolts on an upper sphere joint of Molecule Man.
hazards: suspended load swing over public path
steps: Verify ground bearing mats placed on soft bank soils
Complete lift plan and confirm exclusion zone over public path
Rig torque equipment basket with certified slings and tagline
Execute pick with ground crew guiding tagline
Barricade drop zone until torque work and lowering complete
Inspect rigging and stow before releasing barricades

rubric.pass_if: Written lift plan signed by foreman before setup
All slings and hardware tagged and inspected before the pick
Path closed and signaler posted for full lift duration

scenarios.robot_role: Spot performs pre-lift visual check of bolt access and ground mats from under the structure, keeping crew clear.
